live.instructions: Tools for discovering nearby restaurants and their menus for pickup orders only.

tools.name: search-brand-by-name

name.description: The restaurant brand name to look up locations for

limit.description: Maximum number of locations to return (default 25, minimum 1, maximum 100)

location.description: Optional location to restrict results near (e.g., 'San Francisco, CA' or '94102' or '37.7749, -122.4194'). Only locations within 5 miles are returned.

tools.description: Given a restaurant brand name, return its locations. A name may match multiple brands (e.g. "pizza"); returns up to `limit` locations total. Optionally restrict results to within 5 miles of a location.

tools.name: discover-nearby-restaurants

location.description: The user's physical location (e.g. coordinates, address, or city name, not relative like 'current location').

openOnly.description: If true, only return restaurants currently open. This field defaults to true.

brandName.description: Filter results to a specific restaurant brand (e.g. IHOP, Los Tacos)

radiusMiles.description: Search radius in miles around the location. Defaults to 1 mile. Maximum 5.

customer_intent.description: Brief thematic description of what the customer is looking for, e.g. 'healthy lunch', 'quick breakfast', 'vegetarian options', 'something sweet'. Keep this high-level; do not include personally sensitive information. Maximum 100 characters.

tools.description: Discover restaurants near a given location. Returns a plain English list of restaurants with their names, locations, fulfillment hours, and descriptions.

tools.name: create-cart

unitToken.description: The unit token identifying the location

cartLineSelections.description: Array of cart line selections (items to add to cart)

menuItemId.description: The id for the menu item selected. This id should start with CALI_ prefix.

quantity.description: The quantity of the item selected (minimum 1, maximum 999)

menuItemVariationId.description: Optional id of menu item variation for the item selected. This id should start with CALIV_ prefix.

modifierId.description: The id of the modifier using the CALIM_ prefixed modifier id.

quantity.description: The quantity of this modifier (default 1, minimum 1, maximum 999)

total_price.description: The total price of this modifier

currency.description: The ISO-4217 currency code of this modifier

textModifiers.description: Optional array of text modifier selections

menuItemMenuModifierId.description: The menu item modifier list id using the CALIL_ prefixed item modifier list id

inputtedText.description: The input text of the modifier

discountCodes.description: Optional array of discount codes to apply

fulfillment.description: Optional fulfillment details. Set type to PICKUP for pick-up orders or DELIVERY for delivery orders. Defaults to PICKUP.

tools.description:
Create a cart for a restaurant location using unit token and a list of item selections.
Use standard/first variation if no variation is explicitly specified. Use CALI_ prefixed IDs for menu item,
and CALIV_ prefixed IDs for menu item variations. Fill both menu item and menu item variations when they are available.
Any item requiring a modifier requires a modifierId field (singular, using CALIM_ prefix from the menu's modifier data).
If a modifier has minSelection >= 1, at least one modifier from that list must be included.

tools.name: get-single-menu

brand_name.description: The restaurant brand name (e.g. Los Tacos, IHOP)

location_address.description: The specific restaurant location address (e.g. 123 John St, New York, NY)

customer_intent.description: Brief thematic description of what the customer is looking for, e.g. 'healthy lunch', 'quick breakfast', 'vegetarian options', 'something sweet'. Do NOT put specific menu item names here; use `suggested_items` for those. Do not include any personally sensitive information. Maximum 100 characters.

suggested_items.description: Specific menu item names the customer mentioned or asked about, e.g. 'tiramisu', 'cappuccino', 'chicken sandwich'. Populate this whenever the customer names a dish (even approximately). Do NOT put thematic descriptions here; use `customer_intent` for those.

tools.description: Get menu items for a restaurant location by brand name and address. Returns menu categories, items, prices, and a unit token for placing an order.

tools.name: get-multiple-menus

locations.description: List of restaurant locations to fetch menus for (max 10)

brand_name.description: The restaurant brand name (e.g. Los Tacos, IHOP)

location_address.description: The specific restaurant location address (e.g. 123 John St, New York, NY)

customer_intent.description: Brief thematic description of what the customer is looking for, e.g. 'healthy lunch', 'quick breakfast', 'vegetarian options', 'something sweet'. Do NOT put specific menu item names here; use `suggested_items` for those. Do not include any personally sensitive information. Maximum 100 characters.

suggested_items.description: Specific menu item names the customer mentioned or asked about, e.g. 'tiramisu', 'cappuccino', 'chicken sandwich'. Populate this whenever the customer names a dish (even approximately). Do NOT put thematic descriptions here; use `customer_intent` for those. Applies to every location fetched.

tools.description: Research tool: get plain text menus for multiple restaurant locations. Returns up to 10 menus with item names, descriptions, and prices for comparison and analysis.
